architecture: LeNet-5 style CNN: conv5x5(1->6, pad 2) relu maxpool2, conv5x5(6->16) relu maxpool2, fc 400->120 relu, fc 120->84 relu, fc 84->10

input.layout: channel, row (top to bottom), column (left to right)
input.scaling: x = pixel / 255, so 0.0 is background and 1.0 is full ink
input.dataset_facts: MNIST test images: handwritten digits 0-9, light strokes (high values) on a dark (zero) background, anti-aliased grey levels at stroke edges; each digit was size-normalised to fit a 20x20 box (aspect ratio kept) and centred by its centre of mass in the 28x28 field

conv: cross-correlation as in PyTorch Conv2d: out[o, i, j] = bias[o] + sum_c sum_u sum_v weight[o, c, u, v] * in[c, i + u, j + v] (after zero padding)
flatten: the [16, 5, 5] map is flattened in (channel, row, column) order to 400 values
output: 10 logits, class k = digit k; the prediction is the argmax (logits within 1e-9 x max(1, |max logit|) of the maximum count as tied; ties go to the lowest index)
metric: accuracy on the 10,000 MNIST test images
